admission.justification: Reusing a verdict after its grader dependency changes can preserve a known instrument error and falsely certify the current evaluation.

applicability: New deterministic/judged grade identities and census staleness checks for retained eval attempts.
conditions: Producer metadata names its source and conservative transitive local Python import closure by path and SHA-256.
Missing or changed producer metadata is stale.
Deterministic identity binds named capture/effect/admission inputs; judged identity also binds the exact package and intended judge model.
exclusions: A proof that every possible future verdict-changing input has been enumerated.
A legacy null identity authorizing execution or a skip.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Every grade identifies its concrete producer and shared sources so missing or changed source identity selects stale deterministic results for regrading.
